title: Capture typed prompts as request tasks behind a captureRequests setting (seq 179e)
description:
opum-doc seq 179, item (e), relayed by opum-agent. Design: opum-doc docs/reference/operator-questions-in-quest-design.md at main.

A `prompt.submit` hook, behind a `captureRequests` setting, files one `request` task per prompt the person types, so the work they actually asked for is captured rather than living only in a transcript.

It must NOT capture noise: slash commands, `!` lines, empty prompts, and text submitted by a plugin or a peer session are all skipped. The setting defaults to off, so a workspace opts in.

acceptanceCriteria.text: With captureRequests on, one request task is filed per prompt the person types, and the task records the prompt it came from
Slash commands, ! lines, empty prompts, and plugin- or peer-submitted text are all NOT captured
With captureRequests off -- the default -- nothing is filed
A capture failure is quiet: it never blocks or alters the person's prompt
